digo: Jirimata kulu; Jirimata chetu (Pakia App. VI and main text)
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Swahili: same name 'Jirimata chetu' (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: The 'female' burr-weed, whose hooked fruit-clusters cling to clothes and fur but are gentler than its 'male' partner's.
teaser.sw: Jirimata 'jike', ambaye vishada vya matunda yake vyenye ndoano hunasa kwenye nguo na manyoya ya wanyama, lakini si vikali kama vya mwenzake 'dume'.

summary.en: Jirimata kulu is a straggling weed whose fruits form hooked burrs that catch on clothing and animals. Pakia records it as the 'female' jirimata, because its burrs are less sharp than those of the 'male', Cenchrus mitis.
summary.sw: Jirimata kulu ni gugu linalotanda ovyoovyo ambalo matunda yake hufanya vishada vyenye ndoano vinavyonasa kwenye nguo na wanyama. Pakia anaurekodi kama jirimata 'jike', kwa sababu miiba yake si mikali kama ya 'dume', Cenchrus mitis.

about.en: This is a straggling or sprawling herb with leaves in opposite pairs and spikes of small flowers. As the fruits ripen, the flower clusters turn into round burrs armed with hooked bristles. The burrs come off easily and stick to clothing, sacks and the coats of goats and dogs, which is how the plant spreads.
about.sw: Huu ni mmea mdogo unaotanda ovyoovyo, wenye majani yanayoota kwa jozi zinazotazamana na masuke ya maua madogo. Matunda yanapokomaa, vishada vya maua hugeuka kuwa vishada vya mviringo vilivyojaa vinywele vigumu vyenye ndoano. Vishada hivi hutoka kwa urahisi na kunata kwenye nguo, magunia na manyoya ya mbuzi na mbwa, na hivyo ndivyo mmea huenea.

where.en: It is a weed of farms, field edges, paths and bush, especially where animals and people pass.
where.sw: Ni gugu la mashambani, pembezoni mwa mashamba, njiani na vichakani, hasa mahali wanyama na watu wanapopita.

culture.en: *Jirimata* works almost like a genus label for plants with thorny fruits, and Pakia lists it within *miya*, the wider class of prickly plants. Within the group, Digo people sort species by sex. Sharp, dangerous features are counted as male and gentle, harmless ones as female. *Cenchrus mitis*, with fiercer spines, is *jirimata lume* ('male'). This plant, whose burrs are not very sharp, is *jirimata chetu* ('female').
culture.sw: *Jirimata* hutumika karibu kama jina la jenasi kwa mimea yenye matunda ya miiba, na Pakia anaiorodhesha ndani ya *miya*, kundi pana la mimea yenye miiba. Ndani ya kundi hili, Wadigo hupanga spishi kwa jinsi. Sifa kali na hatari huhesabiwa kuwa za kiume, na zile za upole zisizo na madhara huhesabiwa kuwa za kike. *Cenchrus mitis*, mwenye miiba mikali zaidi, ni *jirimata lume* ('dume'). Mmea huu, ambao miiba yake si mikali sana, ni *jirimata chetu* ('jike').

names.en: Digo: *jirimata kulu* in Pakia's Appendix III. Elsewhere in the thesis it appears as *jirimata chetu*, 'female jirimata', a name shared with Duruma and Swahili. Pakia gives no meaning for *kulu* here. In Mgombato, *-kulu* means large or important. No English name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *jirimata kulu* katika Kiambatisho III cha Pakia. Kwingineko katika tasnifu yake unaonekana kama *jirimata chetu*, 'jirimata jike', jina linaloshirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili. Pakia hatoi maana ya *kulu* hapa. Katika Mgombato, *-kulu* maana yake kubwa au muhimu. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.
